d: Dark espresso brown hair, shoulder-length and wavy with jagged bangs framing the face. Dull crimson eyes with a tired, half-lidded expression. An adolescent appearance with a slender build. Wearing a high-collared, light-purple oversized coat over a revealing white garment, paired with a black choker and a silver key necklace. Accessories include a black mechanical glove with red accents and a bright orange pressurized canister.
